exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to see each other, to meet; to date
to see, to catch sight of, to notice (from afar)
(colloquial) to see, to meet, to see each other
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ви́деться — to see each other, to meet; to date; сновиде́ние — dream, vision (in a dream); зави́деть — to see, to catch sight of, to notice (from afar); повида́ться — (colloquial) to see, to meet, to see each other.
